name: DigitalOcean MCP
description: Manages DigitalOcean apps, Droplets, Kubernetes clusters, databases, and storage from MCP clients, through a hosted router endpoint or a local npx server, for cloud developers.

skills.name: MCP Router
skills.description: Finds the right tool across every DigitalOcean MCP service from a natural-language query, then fetches its schema and runs it.

skills.name: App Platform
skills.description: Manages DigitalOcean App Platform applications from an MCP client, including their deployments and configurations.

skills.name: Droplets
skills.description: Creates, resizes, snapshots, and monitors Droplet virtual machines on DigitalOcean from an MCP client.

skills.name: Kubernetes
skills.description: Manages DigitalOcean Kubernetes (DOKS) clusters and their node pools through the doks MCP service.

skills.name: Managed Databases
skills.description: Provisions, manages, and monitors managed database clusters such as Postgres, MySQL, and Redis on DigitalOcean.
